description: This source file defines a WatchMessagingService class for managing communication with an Apple Watch using WatchConnectivity framework. It includes error handling, session management, message sending, and handling incoming messages related to watch notifications and quick replies.

classes.name: WatchMessagingService
classes.description: Final class managing watch messaging via WCSession, including sending notifications, handling quick replies, and observing session state.

methods.name: isSupportedOnDevice
methods.description: Checks if WatchConnectivity is supported on the device.

methods.name: currentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot status of the current watch connectivity state without needing async.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current watch messaging status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback handler for quick reply events from the watch.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to the watch with specified parameters; handles immediate delivery or queued transfer.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the WCSession is activated before performing operations.
